About WE4HIM

Background and History

WE4HIM Community Based Organization was registered on 6th March, 2024 with the Department of Social Development in Suna East Sub County, Migori County. Our physical office is located at Kakrao Ward Administrator’s building in Paw Nyuka, Kakrao Ward, Suna East Sub County, Migori County.

WE4HIM CBO was established to enhance social, political, environmental and economic empowerment of boys and men in Migori County. It is governed by a Board of Management comprising a Chair Person, Treasurer, and Secretary. The organization adopts a community-centered approach encouraging positive attitudes and behavioral change.

Our primary goal is to inspire meaningful engagement and inclusion in local development initiatives.

Vision

A society where every boy and man is empowered to lead with purpose, thrive with dignity and advance sustainable development.

Mission

To promote and support the engagement, involvement and inclusion of boys and men in meaningful development.

Core Values

  • Community Centred
  • Integrity
  • Meaningful Participation
  • Partnerships and Networking

Why WE4HIM CBO?

The concept of WE4HIM was initially conceived in 2012 by the founder. Over time, societal neglect of boys and men prompted its revitalization. According to the National Gender Equality Commission’s 2015 report, systemic factors have contributed to the marginalization of boys in gender discourse. WE4HIM CBO advocates for their inclusion in development programs across Migori County.

Recent Achievements

In 2024, WE4HIM collaborated with partners and governments in Migori County to commemorate the first ever International Day of the Boy Child on May 6, 2024, at Nyikendo Secondary School.

According to the National Gender Equality Commission’s 2015 ‘Status of the Boy Child Report’, systemic factors have contributed to the marginalization of boys in gender equality discourse. Acknowledging this imbalance and the adverse behaviour stemming from it, WE4HIM CBO was revitalized to advocate for the inclusion of boys and men in development programs and initiatives across Migori County, promoting healthier behaviour and constructive societal contributions.

Sources of Funds

Currently, our initiatives are funded through contributions from committee members and well-wishers. We will further diversify our funding sources by seeking grants, establishing partnerships with local businesses, engaging in community fundraising events, and exploring online crowdfunding platforms to ensure sustainable support for our initiatives.
